name: All Iron Re I Socimi, S.A.
summary: All Iron Re I Socimi, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, acquires, invests in, develops, and leases urban real estate assets for alternative short- and medium-stay accommodation for leisure, business, and other uses in Spain and Hungary. The company has a portfolio of 19 real estate assets with a total of approximately 1,000 serviced apartments and 300 hostel beds. All Iron Re I Socimi, S.A. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Madrid, Spain.
